name: Leejam Sports Company
summary: Leejam Sports Company operates sports and fitness centers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. It also engages in wholesale and retail trade of sportswear and equipment; and real estate and constructs buildings. In addition, the company involved in advertising and public relations activities; and owns hotels, furnished apartments, and other businesses. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
